component.name: Prompter
component.summary: Voice-following teleprompter for the Elgato Prompter

description.p: Prompter turns an Elgato Prompter into a teleprompter on Linux. It listens to your microphone and scrolls the script along as you speak, or at a fixed speed.

ul.li: Scripts are Markdown files; headings become sections you can jump between
Voice follow runs Whisper speech recognition locally, best on an NVIDIA GPU
Eye-line crosshair, camera self-view, and the Prompter's own brightness control
Global shortcuts through your desktop's shortcuts portal
